verdict.rationale: The publish-checks docs offer a "built-in autofix flow" as the in-product alternative to pasting a fix prompt into your own coding agent. That implies a narrow, built-in agentic capability scoped to fixing checklist failures. The official MCP server only lets external agents (Cursor, Claude) manage the platform, so it is not a built-in assistant and earns no credit here. The "Chat" mention appears to be for exercising the user's own MCP server, not a product assistant. missing for 10: documentation that autofix is AI-driven and how it works, a general-purpose in-product AI assistant that accepts delegated tasks beyond autofix, scope/permissions of the assistant, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: copy a fix prompt into your own coding agent, or run the built-in autofix flow
